Common output devices and the kinds of outputs they produce.

questions.prompt: Which device converts a control signal into physical movement?
Which printer builds a three-dimensional object layer by layer?
Name a sensor that measures acidity or alkalinity.
Which sensor measures a device's acceleration?
Explain the roles of a temperature sensor and a fan actuator in an automatic cooling system.
questions.model_answer: The sensor measures temperature and sends the reading to the controller. The actuator switches or drives the fan to change the temperature.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: The sensor measures temperature and sends the reading to the controller.
1: The actuator switches or drives the fan to change the temperature.
questions.student_guidance:
Identify what the first device measures and where it sends the reading.
Describe the physical action produced after the controller decides.

questions.prompt: Explain how a laser printer and an inkjet printer put an image onto paper.
questions.model_answer: A laser printer uses electrostatic attraction to apply dry toner. An inkjet printer sprays droplets of liquid ink onto the paper.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: A laser printer uses electrostatic attraction to apply dry toner.
1: An inkjet printer sprays droplets of liquid ink onto the paper.
questions.student_guidance:
Consider how one printer applies a dry powdered material.
Consider how the other printer deposits a liquid on the page.
